voices.description: A Korean voice for spoken explanations, service introductions, and informational narration. Recorded in Korean with a Seoul accent. Best suited to natural, conversational delivery.

voices.name: MJ - Clear, Calm, Natural
voices.description: Natural Korean adult male voice with a clear, balanced mid-range tone and crisp articulation. Calm, thoughtful, and trustworthy, with a conversational yet polished delivery. The voice is expressive without sounding theatrical, making it suitable for narration, explainers, education, reviews, storytelling, podcasts, branded content, and long-form videos. Approachable, mature, and easy to listen to over extended periods.

voices.name: Suzie - Calm Korean

voices.name: Yoojin Kim - Bright, Clear & Friendly
voices.description: Young Korean female voice with a bright, clear, and naturally friendly tone. Great for commercials, product introductions, social media ads, brand content, and conversational narration. Native Korean with a standard Korean accent.
